Blessing Muzarabani to Mohammad Akram, out Caught by Sikandar Raza!! Mohammad Akram goes. He shadow-practices the forward defence after playing an ugly shot. Hard back of a length into the pitch on off-stump, Akram tries to pull and is in no position at all. High on the bat and a total miscue, it lobs to mid-off for the simplest of catches. 20:51 Local Time, 16:51 GMT, 22:21 IST: A thrashing this as Afghanistan clean-sweep Zimbabwe. Smiles from Azmatullah Omarzai and Ibrahim Zadran as they chat while Sikandar Raza just puts his head down and walks off. He will vent it out in the post-match presentation. That's for sure. I will be keenly listening to what he says. This was an easy chase once Zimbabwe folded for 79. Mohammad Akram started in a hurry and wanted to end this very early but after a hat-trick of fours, he fell to Muzarabani in the opening over. Masuku struck twice in one over to bring some cheer for his side but the eventual result was never in doubt. The whole game lasted 22.4 overs and if there was one moment which summed up Zimbabwe's fortunes tonight, then it was Tadiwanashe Marumani's drop of Omarzai and the subsequent reactions from Muzarabani and Raza. Stay tuned for the post-match stuff....

Tarakhail 2/2: [On the inspiration behind his unusual bowling action, compared with Lasith Malinga and Shaun Tait] If I talk about that, I have also followed fast bowlers. It is my natural action. My coaches have always told me during practice that I should not make changes to it. They tell me that the action I have naturally is very good. So that is the reason. There is nothing particularly special behind it.

Ibrahim Zadran | Afghanistan captain 1/2: [On Afghanistan's overall performance and winning the T20I series against Zimbabwe] Very good series. I'm so happy, you know, with the overall performance and the energy the guys put in. In each and every game, they have shown discipline. That's why, you know, we won three in a row. They have played very good cricket. [On whether he felt pressure as captain, given Afghanistan's previous record of never losing a series to Zimbabwe] To be honest, I heard about it, but I didn't think about it. I was just thinking that we would try to go with a positive mindset and give 100 percent. Then we cannot think about the result. What we can think about is only the process, which is, you know, in our hands. This is what we were doing in every game, and yeah, we just delivered that. And every game, we got the result.
Ibrahim Zadran is presented the winning trophy and he is all smiles. Then he gives it to Abdullah Tarakhail as the entire Afghanistan contingent pose as a group for the cameras.

A whitewash by Afghanistan and Zimbabwe have a lot of things to ponder as we move to the Tests next. That starts on the 5th of November in Sharjah. Will a change of format bring a change in fortunes for Zimbabwe? We will wait and see. We will be there nice and early for the 1st Test. Do join us then. For now that's it from all of us here. Bye bye and take care.
